title: Inovar Packaging Group — claimed by thegentlemen
description: AU · Manufacturing · inovarpackaging.com Inovar Packaging Group (Irving, TX) is a PE-backed buy-and-build platform producing pressure-sensitive labels, shrink sleeves, flexible packaging, and RFID — 14 US plants, 12+ acquisitions since 2016 (latest: Kiliper Corp, Feb 2026). Owned by Kelso & Company since May 2022 (previously AEA Investors); CEO/Chairman Jeff Brezek leads, with deal advisors Milbank and Mesirow confirm
